facts.fact: Revenues totaled $31.6 billion, up 2.3% year over year.
facts.quote: Revenues totaled $31.6 billion, up 2.3% from the year-ago quarter
facts.location: first bullet under Second-Quarter Consolidated Results; first bullet under Consolidated Financial Results
equivalent_phrasings: versus $30.8 billion in the year-ago quarter
common_errors: reporting Advanced Connectivity segment operating revenues ($28,615 million, up 4.1%) as total revenue
reporting Advanced Connectivity service revenue growth of 5.1% as consolidated revenue growth
describing the growth as organic (it includes the first-quarter Lumen mass markets fiber acquisition and favorable foreign exchange in Mexico)

facts.fact: GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations was $0.66, versus $0.62 in the year-ago quarter.
facts.quote: Earnings per diluted common share from continuing operations was $0.66, versus $0.62 in the year-ago quarter.
facts.location: second bullet under Second-Quarter Consolidated Results; income paragraph under Consolidated Financial Results
common_errors: labeling $0.66 as adjusted EPS or $0.65 as GAAP EPS (GAAP EPS is the higher of the two this quarter)

misstating the net $(0.01) bridge from GAAP $0.66 to adjusted $0.65 (it removes a $0.05 benefit from tax items and adds back a $0.03 asset abandonment charge and $0.01 for benefit-related, transaction, legal and other items), for example by attributing the gap to the tax benefit and the abandonment charge alone
treating the year-ago $0.62 as a clean base (it included $0.05 of equity in net income of DIRECTV)
citing income from continuing operations attributable to common stock ($4.6 billion) as income from continuing operations ($5.0 billion), or the reverse
stating a computed growth rate the release does not print (for example about 6%)

facts.fact: Adjusted EPS (non-GAAP) was $0.65, versus $0.54 in the year-ago quarter.
facts.quote: Diluted EPS from continuing operations was $0.66, versus $0.62 in the year-ago quarter; adjusted EPS* was $0.65, versus $0.54 in the year-ago quarter
facts.location: second bullet under Second-Quarter Consolidated Results; reconciliation paragraph in Non-GAAP Measures section
common_errors: presenting $0.65 as GAAP EPS
comparing adjusted $0.65 against the GAAP year-ago $0.62 instead of the adjusted year-ago $0.54
presenting a computed growth rate (about 20%) as a figure the release printed (it prints none for EPS)

facts.fact: Advanced Connectivity segment service revenue was $23.5 billion, up 5.1% year over year.
facts.quote: Advanced Connectivity service revenue of $23.5 billion, up 5.1% year over year
facts.location: Second-Quarter Highlights bullet; Service row of the Advanced Connectivity segment table (23,478 vs 22,334)
common_errors: confusing service revenue growth (5.1%) with total Advanced Connectivity segment revenue growth (4.1%, $28,615 million)
reporting wireless service revenue ($17,413 million, up 3.3%) as the segment service total
reading the segment table in billions instead of millions

facts.fact: Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) was $12.3 billion, up 5.2% year over year.
facts.quote: Income from continuing operations was $5.0 billion, up 3.6% year over year; adjusted EBITDA* was $12.3 billion, up 5.2% year over year
facts.location: fourth bullet under Second-Quarter Consolidated Results; adjusted EBITDA bullet under Consolidated Financial Results
equivalent_phrasings: versus $11.7 billion in the year-ago quarter
common_errors: confusing consolidated adjusted EBITDA ($12.3 billion, up 5.2%) with Advanced Connectivity segment EBITDA ($12.0 billion, up 8.0%)
labeling adjusted EBITDA as a GAAP measure
confusing the quarter's 5.2% growth with the 2026 guidance of 3% to 4% adjusted EBITDA growth

facts.fact: AT&T reiterated its full-year 2026 guidance, including adjusted EPS (non-GAAP) of $2.25 to $2.35.
facts.quote: Adjusted EPS* of $2.25 to $2.35 in 2026 with a double-digit 3-year CAGR through 2028
facts.location: long-term outlook bullets under Outlook and Capital Allocation Plan; second subheadline says all consolidated full-year 2026 and multi-year guidance is reiterated
common_errors: saying guidance was raised (it was reiterated; only the 2026 buyback pace was accelerated)
presenting the range as GAAP EPS guidance (the company gives no GAAP EPS range and says it cannot reconcile without unreasonable effort)
stating a specific multi-year CAGR (the release says only double-digit)
confusing with other 2026 guidance: free cash flow of $18 billion+, adjusted EBITDA growth of 3% to 4%, capital investment of $23 billion to $24 billion

facts.fact: AT&T is accelerating share repurchases to approximately $10 billion in 2026, within approximately $24 billion of planned repurchases over 2026-2028.
facts.quote: Strong capital returns, including plans to maintain its current annualized common stock dividend of $1.11 per share and approximately $24 billion of share repurchases, including approximately $10 billion during 2026
facts.location: capital returns bullet under Outlook and Capital Allocation Plan; second subheadline and CEO quote on the accelerated 2026 pace
equivalent_phrasings: about $10 billion of buybacks this year
common_errors: confusing the approximately $10 billion 2026 plan with the $4.1 billion returned in the quarter or the approximately $2.2 billion repurchased in the quarter
confusing $24 billion of planned repurchases with the $45 billion+ total capital return plan for 2026-2028, which includes dividends
claiming the dividend was raised (the $1.11 annualized dividend is maintained)

facts.fact: Free cash flow (non-GAAP) was $4.7 billion, versus $4.4 billion in the year-ago quarter.
facts.quote: Free cash flow* was $4.7 billion, versus $4.4 billion in the year-ago quarter.
facts.location: free cash flow bullet under Second-Quarter Consolidated Results and Consolidated Financial Results
common_errors: reporting cash from operating activities ($10.8 billion, GAAP) as free cash flow
labeling free cash flow as a GAAP measure
confusing the quarter's $4.7 billion with 2026 free cash flow guidance of $18 billion+
stating a computed growth rate the release does not print (for example about 7%)

facts.quote: Legacy segment revenues were down 25.9% year over year, primarily due to lower demand for services as the Company continues to decommission its copper-based network.
facts.location: paragraph below the Legacy segment table (quote); Operating Revenues row of the Legacy segment table, in dollars in millions: 'Operating Revenues | 1,632 | 2,202 | (25.9)'
common_errors: confusing the Legacy revenue decline (25.9%) with the Legacy operating income decline (45.5%, to $523 million)
citing the 2026 guidance of a 20%+ Legacy service revenue decline as the quarter's result
reading the table in billions instead of millions

facts.fact: Advanced Connectivity internet net adds were 646,000 (a record for combined fiber and fixed wireless), and postpaid phone net adds were 432,000.
facts.quote: 646,000 total consumer and business Advanced Connectivity internet net adds, including 367,000 fiber and 279,000 fixed wireless
facts.location: Second-Quarter Highlights bullet (quote covers the 646,000); the 432,000 is in the next Highlights bullet, '432,000 postpaid phone net adds with postpaid phone churn of 0.86%', and in the Segment Results intro paragraph ('postpaid phone net adds were 432,000'); the record is in the lead paragraph ('a record quarter for combined fiber and fixed wireless net adds'); the first subheadline and first Highlights bullet frame the quarter as 'Added over 1 million Advanced Connectivity customers'
equivalent_phrasings: 646,000 fiber and fixed wireless net adds
367,000 fiber and 279,000 fixed wireless net adds
record combined fiber and fixed wireless net adds
added over 1 million Advanced Connectivity customers
common_errors: confusing 646,000 Advanced Connectivity internet net adds with 432,000 postpaid phone net adds
reporting 367,000 fiber net adds as total internet net adds (the 646,000 includes 279,000 fixed wireless)
calling it a fiber-only record (the record is for combined fiber and fixed wireless net adds)

confusing the more than 1 million Advanced Connectivity customers added with the more than 1 million locations reached with fiber (38.6 million total), or describing the 1 million as postpaid phone adds
stating a computed customer total (for example 1,078,000) the release does not print (it says only over 1 million)

traps: GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations ($0.66) is higher than adjusted EPS ($0.65) this quarter: the net $(0.01) adjustment removes a $0.05 benefit from tax items and adds back a $0.03 asset abandonment charge and $0.01 for benefit-related, transaction, legal and other items; swapping the two or assuming adjusted exceeds GAAP misstates the release.

Customer adds: over 1 million Advanced Connectivity customers (646,000 internet net adds, 367,000 fiber plus 279,000 fixed wireless, and 432,000 postpaid phone net adds) is not the more than 1 million fiber locations added (38.6 million total).
Postpaid phone churn was 0.86% (not 8.6% or 0.86 basis points), printed alongside the 432,000 postpaid phone net adds.
Year-ago comparisons differ by basis: GAAP $0.62 (included $0.05 of DIRECTV equity income) vs adjusted $0.54.
Segment vs total: consolidated revenue $31.6 billion (up 2.3%) vs Advanced Connectivity segment revenue $28,615 million (up 4.1%) vs Advanced Connectivity service revenue $23,478 million (up 5.1%).
Segment vs total: consolidated adjusted EBITDA $12.3 billion (up 5.2%) vs Advanced Connectivity EBITDA $12.0 billion (up 8.0%); both are non-GAAP.

GAAP vs non-GAAP pairs: operating income $7.0 billion vs adjusted operating income $7.5 billion; capital expenditures $5.7 billion vs capital investment $6.1 billion (adds $0.4 billion vendor financing); cash from operations $10.8 billion vs free cash flow $4.7 billion.

Guidance was reiterated, not raised; the change is the accelerated 2026 buyback pace to approximately $10 billion, within approximately $24 billion of repurchases and $45 billion+ of total capital returns (including dividends) for 2026-2028.
Quarter vs full year: 2026 guidance figures (adjusted EPS $2.25 to $2.35, free cash flow $18 billion+, adjusted EBITDA growth 3% to 4%) are not quarterly results.
Units: segment tables are in millions while the bullets are in billions; Legacy revenue of 1,632 is $1.6 billion.
Continuing operations: the acquired Lumen fiber network assets are held for sale and reported as discontinued operations; EPS, income and guidance are on a continuing operations basis.
Net debt is $126.4 billion (non-GAAP); total debt is $144.0 billion.
Quarterly capital return was $4.1 billion including approximately $2.2 billion of repurchases; the approximately $10 billion is the full-year 2026 plan.
